cohort: The study included 754,300 singleton pregnancies (> 12 weeks) of Danish women, with pregnancies ending between 1998 and 2009.
finding: Pregnant women with prescriptions for montelukast had a higher risk of preterm birth, maternal preeclampsia, and gestational diabetes, but no increased risk of major congenital anomalies was found.
cross-section timing: Pregnancies ending between 1998 and 2009, with exposure defined from 3 months before the last menstrual period until the end of the first trimester.
